title: Gate: a clean merge is not a conflict resolution
goal: The gate marked every task review of plan runtime-quirks STALE after the topic merged main, although no file needed a hand resolution. _uncovered_changes (scripts/factory-pipeline.py) finds a merge's own resolutions with `git diff-tree --cc --name-only`, which lists every file changed on both sides of the merge, also when git merged it cleanly and the combined diff has no hunk (merge 2674fe6 listed 7 files, only docs/plans/backlog.md had a combined hunk). A merge's own resolutions are the files with a combined hunk.

tasks.objective: In scripts/factory-pipeline.py _uncovered_changes, the three places that read a merge's own changes with `git diff-tree --cc --name-only --no-commit-id -r <merge> -- <owned paths>` (the topic merge 'evil' set, a commit brought in from the default branch, and a sync merge on a task branch) use one helper that returns only the files with a combined hunk: run `git diff-tree --cc -p --no-commit-id -r <merge> -- <paths>` and take the file names of its `diff --cc <file>` headers (git prints a header only for a file whose combined diff keeps a hunk; a binary file with a resolution keeps its header). A git error keeps the current fail-safe (every owned path). Nothing else changes: a hand resolution in an owned file, a direct topic commit and a later real change still make the review STALE.
acceptance: gate-merge: the topic changes an owned file after the review is recorded at a later SHA, the default branch changes another region of the same file, and the topic merges the default branch cleanly: the gate stays READY_FOR_PR with no STALE line
the same shape where the merge needs a hand resolution in that owned file makes the review STALE naming the file
the existing evil-merge, subtask-evil-merge and stack-sync-evil cases still report their resolution
